Done. Plan written to [doc/CLOUDFLARE.md](doc/CLOUDFLARE.md), with [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) updated to point at it.

**Key architectural decisions in the plan**:

- **Deployment platform as an orthogonal axis** (`node | cloudflare`) — does not collapse into the existing auth/exposure axes, leaves `local_trusted` / `authenticated` semantics untouched.
- **Phase 1 = Hyperdrive + Neon Postgres**, not D1. The Drizzle schema uses `jsonb` ([packages/db/src/schema/plugins.ts](packages/db/src/schema/plugins.ts) and others); D1 (SQLite) would force a schema port before anything else works. Phase 1 ships in weeks; Phase 2 (D1) is opt-in.
- **5 minimum upstream seams** — each is independently mergeable and improves the Node deployment too: DB factory split, Scheduler interface, transport-agnostic HTTP `Handler`, `CommandExecutor` interface, storage provider extension point.
- **Express → Hono is incremental, not a rewrite** — introduce a transport-agnostic handler shape, migrate routes one module at a time, hot path first. Until migrated, Workers can fall back to invoking Express handlers via a stream shim.
- **Plugin execution stays in sandboxes** — Workers can't spawn processes, so the existing E2B/SSH sandbox bridge ([#4801](https://github.com/.../pull/4801), [#4803](https://github.com/.../pull/4803)) is the default executor; Cloudflare Containers is opt-in.
- **Per-task DOs with WebSocket Hibernation** + **Workflows for multi-step orchestration** — keeps idle cost at ~$5–6/mo by ensuring nothing is billed when nothing is happening.
- **Setup flow writes to encrypted DB config**, not per-Worker secrets — single source of truth, no CF-API sync, secrets propagate instantly.

The plan includes a 13-step PR sequence (§15) where PRs #1–#7 are upstream improvements that land independently and #8–#13 are the additive `packages/deploy-cloudflare/` work. Nothing in the CF package blocks upstream review.

Want me to start on PR #1 (DB factory split — smallest, lowest-risk, unblocks everything else)?
